verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an SSH/Mosh terminal client with file transfer (scp/sftp) and remote coding environment connectivity (VS Code, Codespaces, GitPod), but no evidence shows any built-in or integrated capability to create pull requests on GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket — it merely provides shell access where a user could manually run git or gh CLI, which is not documented as a product feature.
